reference_sql:
WITH user_payments AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded, with its user and its UTC month
  SELECT s.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS pay_month
  FROM payments AS p
  JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
),
cohorts AS (
  -- one row per paying user: the UTC month of the first payment
  SELECT user_id, MIN(pay_month) AS cohort_month
  FROM user_payments
  GROUP BY user_id
),
retained AS (
  -- one row per user who paid in the third month after the cohort month
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id
  FROM cohorts AS c
  JOIN user_payments AS up
    ON up.user_id = c.user_id
   AND up.pay_month = CAST(c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE)
)
SELECT c.cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(r.user_id) AS retained_m3_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.user_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS retention_m3_pct
FROM cohorts AS c
LEFT JOIN retained AS r ON r.user_id = c.user_id
WHERE c.cohort_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND c.cohort_month < DATE '2025-07-01'
GROUP BY c.cohort_month
ORDER BY c.cohort_month

WITH user_payments AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded, with its user, its UTC month and the user's first month
  SELECT s.user_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS pay_month,
         MIN(CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.user_id) AS cohort_month
  FROM payments AS p
  JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, pay_month) = 3 THEN user_id END) AS retained_m3_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, pay_month) = 3 THEN user_id END)
             / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 1) AS retention_m3_pct
FROM user_payments
WHERE cohort_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND cohort_month < DATE '2025-07-01'
GROUP BY cohort_month
ORDER BY cohort_month

WITH user_payments AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded, with its user and its UTC month
  SELECT s.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS pay_month
  FROM payments AS p
  JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
),
cohorts AS (
  -- one row per paying user: the UTC month of the first payment
  SELECT user_id, MIN(pay_month) AS cohort_month
  FROM user_payments
  GROUP BY user_id
),
user_flags AS (
  -- one row per user of a cohort from January to June 2025, flagged 1 when the user paid in month 3
  SELECT c.user_id, c.cohort_month,
         MAX(CASE WHEN up.pay_month = CAST(c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_m3
  FROM cohorts AS c
  JOIN user_payments AS up ON up.user_id = c.user_id
  WHERE c.cohort_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.cohort_month < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY c.user_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       SUM(paid_m3) AS retained_m3_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(paid_m3) / COUNT(*), 1) AS retention_m3_pct
FROM user_flags
GROUP BY cohort_month
ORDER BY cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT sub.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', pay.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS mo
  FROM payments pay JOIN subscriptions sub ON sub.subscription_id = pay.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT pay.refunded
), coh AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(mo) AS cohort_month FROM p GROUP BY user_id
), c AS (
  SELECT coh.cohort_month, coh.user_id,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM p WHERE p.user_id = coh.user_id AND p.mo = coh.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AS ret
  FROM coh
  WHERE coh.cohort_month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND coh.cohort_month <= DATE '2025-06-01'
)
SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ret) AS retained_m3_users,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ret) / COUNT(*), 1) AS retention_m3_pct
FROM c GROUP BY cohort_month ORDER BY cohort_month
